claim: The system was evaluated against a request without a valid authorization receipt.

checks.method: Submit a mutation request without a valid operator authorization receipt
checks.reason: The request was accepted, although the negative-control policy required denial.
checks.observed: The unauthorized mutation request was accepted.

checks.method: Replay a previously used authorization receipt and verify that the second use is rejected.
checks.reason: The replay-control case was not executed in this example run.

limitations: Illustrative failure fixture only; no live system or real host mutation is asserted.
The fixture demonstrates that a required negative control can fail while another required check remains not run.

conclusion.summary: The example system accepted an unauthorized request, so a required denial check failed. A second required control was not run.
conclusion.policy: Any failed required check makes the overall result FAIL; a required check that is not run cannot be treated as passing.
